values: 一名优雅的法师，能为自身和友军提升攻击速度，擅长应对站位密集的敌人。
An elegant mage who enhances her own ATK SPD and that of her allies, she's especially powerful at taking down grouped enemies.
The most beautiful flowers can have the sharpest thorns.
Listen to the voice of the flowers.
胜利，是最为美丽的绽放
让花朵开遍这片土地吧
May flowers blossom across this land.
May the Lucent Tree bestow its blessings upon all.
生命的新芽真让人感动。
The buds of new life are truly inspiring.
又到了繁花盛放的季节，来，一起观赏吧？
It's the season to blossom once more. Come, admire them with me.
我……很少见到这么美丽的礼物！不、不能失态……谢谢你。
I've seldom seen such a beautiful gift! I... mustn't lose composure. Thank you.
无功不受禄，但……一片心意，我会收下的。
I need no reward but will always accept a heartfelt gesture.
在林中漫步的身影，比任何花朵都更美丽。
The figure that walks through the forest is prettier than all the flowers combined.
溪水穿越丛林，枯萎的枝蔓也会发出新芽。
Jungle rivers flow, bringing life to withered branches and vines.
参与活动“对决战略”可得该皮肤。
I've brought some new flowers over.
You need to balance work and leisure.
Would you like to try the new herbal tea?
Let's add more flowers to the decorations.
The lights in the snow are so warm and inviting.
帕瑞莎喜爱喝各种花茶，其中不乏功效强劲的种类。这是她平淡生活中唯一有些出格的小爱好。
Parisa enjoys drinking all kinds of scented teas, including some that contain powerful effects. This is the only somewhat eccentric hobby in her otherwise normal life.
在偶尔休假的日子，帕瑞莎常睡过整个白天，然后在夜晚自责地醒来。
On her occasional time off, Parisa often sleeps through the entire day, only to wake up at night and feel guilty about it.
整个荆棘卫队中，帕瑞莎休假是最少的。
Among all the Thorned Guards, Parisa receives the least amount of time off.
据年长的教师们回忆，学生时代的帕瑞莎总是在比赛中获得第二名的好成绩。
According to some of the older professors, Parisa often placed second in her competitions when she was still a student.
“队长虽然很好，但总觉得她对自己和部下都有点太苛刻了……”一名已经离开荆棘卫队的队员说。
"Captain's great and all, but sometimes it felt like she was too harsh on herself... and on her subordinates, too."—A retired Thorned Guard.
据荆棘卫队的成员说，帕瑞莎当上队长后，亲手铲掉了许多过去种下的花田，因为这些爱好会令她在工作中分心。
According to other Thorned Guards, Parisa immediately dug up many of her flower beds upon her promotion to captain, saying that her hobbies would only distract her from her work.
据莱卡说，学生时代的帕瑞莎，有时会避开大家，和自己种下的花儿说话。
According to Lyca, Parisa would often avoid everyone during her academy days and share her secrets with the flowers.
帕瑞莎擅长窨制花茶，莱卡常向她借取茶叶，不仅用来喝，也用来占卜。

"Parisa is very skilled at preparing scented teas. I sometimes use them for divination. Most of the time, I just enjoy the taste." Lyca said this when she was preparing a pot for Florabelle one night.
帕瑞莎最介意莱卡的地方之一，就是莱卡非常相信预示和命运。在她看来，没有什么比紧紧握在手中的努力和勤勉更为重要。

One of the things that bothers Parisa most about Lyca is her unwavering belief in omens and destiny. To Parisa, nothing is more important than determining one's own destiny through hard work and diligence.
据说，帕瑞莎是在伊米尔真正属意的候选人拒绝后，才得到了成为队长的机会。但帕瑞莎仍然对此充满感激。
They say that Parisa was only promoted to captain because Eomir's original candidate declined the position. Either way, she is grateful for the opportunity.
嗯……这么多花草，哪些泡茶会好一点呢……
Hmm, so many herbs... What would make the best tea?
之前第四小队提交过报告，希望能增配人手……
Squad 4 has submitted requests for extra hands before...
我已经很久没有见到过妖精了……上一次，是什么时候来着？
It's been a long time since I last saw a fairy. I don't even remember when the last time was.
I've brought some new flowers over.
Would you like to try the new herbal tea?
Let's add more flowers to the decorations.
The lights in the snow are so warm and inviting.
没想到，我们好不容易再见面，却是在这样的情况下……
I didn't expect our reunion to happen in such circumstances...
帕瑞莎 & 莱卡 & 卡夫拉
说起来，我们三个真是难得聚在一起。
It's rare for the three of us to get together!
莱卡 & 埃隆 & 帕瑞莎
无论看到多少次，卡夫拉这把大剑的威慑力还是很强……
No matter how many times I see it, Kafra's sword just looks intimidating...
莱卡 & 卡夫拉 & 帕瑞莎
